name: Berne (United States)
description: White field with a red border, charged with a black bear with a red tongue and claws below the name BERNE in black, after the arms of Bern in Switzerland.
history: Berne is a city in Adams County, Indiana, settled in 1852 by Mennonite immigrants from Switzerland and named after the Swiss capital; the flag borrows the bear of the arms of Bern.

features.role: walking bear with red tongue and claws, after the arms of Bern
